Name: VolcanoFarms 2
Author: Wandox99
Description:
[size=3]Hello Everyone!
This is the [i]VolcanoFarms2[/i] mod.

[/size][size=3][i]The activity of an underground volcano devastated this land, but it remained fertile. Perhaps, it will bless you with some gifts.
[/i]

[/size][size=3]This mod change the Vanilla's FarmMap (Standard, Riverland, Forest, Mountain, Wilderness, Four Corner and the Beach) with Volcano Dungeon themed Maps.

For work, this mod require:
[i]SMAPI[/i] by [i]Pathoschild[/i];
[i]Content Patcher[/i] by [i]Pathoschild[/i];
[i]Farm Type Manage[/i]r by [i]Esca-MMC[/i].

The zip file has 5 folder inside:
[CP]VolcanoFarms2;
[CP]VolcanoFarm_Minimap_2;
[CP]VolcanoFarm_intro_U_2I;
[FTM] VolcanoFarm_DailySpawn2;
[FTM] VolcanoFarm_FirstSetup2.
You need all of them when you are creating a new Farm for a "full experience".

There is a optional file:
[FTM] VolcanoFarm_More_DailySpawn2, use this instead of [FTM] VolcanoFarm_DailySpawn2 if you want more items spawn on the farm.

For avoid bug or glitch: Do not use old save with this mods.

For more details, I've writed a README.txt inside [CP]VolcanoFarms2 mod folder.



[size=4]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]



If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url] with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels

Downloads.Description: This zip contain the main mods for VolcanoFarms2

Manifest.Name: VolcanoFarms2
Manifest.Description: Farm map based on the volcano.
Manifest.Author: Wandox99

Manifest.Name: VolcanoFarm_Intro_UI_2
Manifest.Description: VolcanoFarm description in the NEW menù, used in combination with VolcanoFarm mod and all set.
Manifest.Author: Wandox99

Manifest.Name: VolcanoFarm_Minimap_2
Manifest.Description: This mod is an optional mod for the VolcanoFarms2, it change the minimap in the menù, don't use it if you are already using mods that change anything of vanilla's minimap.

Manifest.Name: FTM_VolcanoFarm_DailySpawn2
Manifest.Description: This mod is used by FTM for the daily spawning of Dragon tooth, Magma cap and allow various monster to spawn on the VolcanoFarm.
Manifest.Author: Wandox99

Manifest.Name: FTM_VolcanoFarm_FirstSetup2
Manifest.Description: This mod is used by FTM, it's useful for the first setup, allowing the massive spawning of rock and boulder. It work only the first year, day 1 in spring.
Manifest.Author: Wandox99
